title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues the structural analysis from the preceding pages of 'variations sur l'équation des lacets', part of the Longue Marche / Grothendieck–Teichmüller circle. The ambient object 𝔊 is a profinite group of elliptic (SL(2,Z)-type) character, with a variant 𝔊^♮ (§ in the previous page's transcription). The next page treats 𝔊 as the 'universal case' Ell(2,Z)^. ρ and σ are distinguished elliptic elements of this group.

The groups in play are as follows.
- M_{ρ,σ}, M^♮_{ρ,σ} are groups of (outer or semi-) automorphisms preserving the conjugacy classes of ρ and σ. Elements are written as triples (a,b,U).
- N_ρ^♮ and N_σ^♮ are the normalizers of ρ and σ.
- γ_{ρ,σ} is a common quotient of these normalizers, and Γ_{ρ,σ} = N_ρ^♮ ×_{γ_{ρ,σ}} N_σ^♮ is their fibre product.
- Z_{ρ,σ} is an extension of Γ_{ρ,σ} by L_0^♮.

On the previous page, (106) identifies the extension M_{ρ,σ}[0] of Γ_{ρ,σ} by L_0^♮ with S_0Γ_{ρ,σ}. That is the pull-back of the extension Z_{ρ,σ} along a canonical homomorphism.

This page proceeds in four steps.
1. Formula (107) records the projection Γ_{ρ,σ} = N_ρ^♮ ×_γ N_σ^♮ → γ_{ρ,σ}.
2. Grothendieck observes that a section of Γ_{ρ,σ} over γ_{ρ,σ} (whose existence and choice were discussed at p. 636' ff.) yields a section of S_0Γ_{ρ,σ} → Γ_{ρ,σ}. Via (106) this gives a splitting of M_{ρ,σ}[0] → Γ_{ρ,σ}. Read in modern terms: the extension Z is pulled back from a situation where the chosen section trivializes it.
3. Once the section is fixed, its image is a subgroup M_{ρ,σ}(0) ⊂ M^♮_{ρ,σ} mapping isomorphically onto Γ_{ρ,σ}.
4. Formula (108) gives the resulting semidirect-product decompositions:
   - M[0] ≅ M(0)·L_0^♮,
   - M^♮ ≅ M(0)·𝔊^♮,
   - M ≅ M(0)·𝔊.
   These are the analogues of (104)–(105), where M(ρ) and M(σ) played the role of complements. M(0) is a third, 'symmetric' choice of complement to the inner part, adapted to the stabilizer of the pair (ρ,σ) rather than to ρ or σ alone.

Purpose: to get a concrete splitting of the automorphism group into an 'inner' part (𝔊, 𝔊^♮, L_0^♮) and a complement isomorphic to Γ_{ρ,σ}. This prepares §8, which returns to the universal case and studies the homomorphism M^ς → M^ς_{ρ,σ}/μ_ς. That is a step in describing a GT-like group as automorphisms of the profinite completion of SL(2,Z) / B_3 respecting the elliptic generators.
errors: This page does not explain why a section of Γ_{ρ,σ} → γ_{ρ,σ} induces a section of S_0Γ_{ρ,σ} → Γ_{ρ,σ}. The justification presumably relies on the precise construction of Z_{ρ,σ} given on earlier pages (around p. 636'), which are not available here, so the step cannot be fully checked.
The decompositions (108) also need M(0) ∩ 𝔊^♮ = 1 and M^♮ = M[0]·𝔊^♮ (respectively the analogue for 𝔊). These are implicit by analogy with (104)–(105) and are not verified on the page.

ideas.what: Choosing a section of the fibre product of normalizers over its common quotient to split the extension M[0] → Γ_{ρ,σ}, giving a complement M(0)
ideas.modern_name: splitting of a pulled-back group extension / choice of complement in a semidirect product

ideas.what: Semidirect-product decomposition of automorphism groups of a profinite SL(2,Z)-type group preserving elliptic conjugacy classes: M ≅ M(0)·𝔊
ideas.modern_name: decomposition Aut = Out-lift ⋉ Inn for automorphism groups of profinite completions of SL(2,Z)/B_3 (GT-type groups)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld, Ihara, Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura, Harbater–Schneps (GT and automorphisms of braid groups / SL2(Z)^)
ideas.where_published: Only the general programme appears in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); these computations are unpublished.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a short bookkeeping step. It fixes a section and records three semidirect-product decompositions analogous to those on the previous page. There is no new idea beyond the context of the larger manuscript.
transcription_corrections: Line 3: the first symbol is a crossed-out 'Z' overwritten by 'Γ'. It should read 'Γ_{ρ,σ} sur γ_{ρ,σ}'.
In (107) the superscripts are the same ♮/§-type sign as on the previous page: N_ρ^♮ ×_{γ_{ρ,σ}} N_σ^♮.
'on dénote en quelque sorte par' is uncertain. The sense is 'on dénote son image (la section) par M_{ρ,σ}(0)'.
The opening word is probably 'Dès' or 'Dans' rather than 'Donc' ('Dès la donnée d'une section…').
In (108) the curly letters are 𝔊^♮ and 𝔊 (the ambient group), matching (104)–(105).
